test_get_sequence_of_considered_visits: test the seq_halving.get_sequence_of_considered_visits function with various simulation budgets and action counts
test_score_considered: test the seq_halving.score_considered function for computing argmax scores with gumbel noise and visit penalties
test_get_table_of_considered_visits: test the seq_halving.get_table_of_considered_visits function to generate visit count tables for all action counts
test_seq_halving_min_sims: test seq_halving with minimum simulations equal to max_num_considered_actions times log2 of max_num_considered_actions
test_seq_halving_not_power_of_2: test seq_halving with max_num_considered_actions that is not a power of 2
